subject: EU Residency MAP orchestration: roles, cross-border checklist, and close windows
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@eurobank.com>, Pieter van Dijk <p.vandijk@eurobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: EU Residency MAP orchestration: roles, cross-border checklist, and close windows

Hi Claire / Pieter —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to formalize a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on EU data residency and the cross-border review you requested so we can align stakeholders, evaluation milestones, and close windows.

Attached: MAP-orchestration-template-v1.xlsx (our suggested owner/assignee matrix), redwood-eu-data-flow-diagram.pdf (high-level flow), SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (summary).

Proposed owners from Redwood:
- Markus Klein (Sales Lead) — overall MAP coordination
- Laura Bennett (AE) — POC for product demos and evaluation plan
- Kimberly Park (Security & Compliance) — controls evidence and technical security Qs
- Rishi Malhotra (Customer Success) — staging integration and success criteria

High-level ask: can EuroBank confirm the DPO and legal contacts we should loop in, and whether an internal data flow review or an external audit will be required for cross-border transfers?

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Week 1 (Jul 5–9): Stakeholder roster + sign-off on MAP owners
- Week 2 (Jul 12–16): Technical eval window (staging access, sample flows)
- Week 4 (Aug 9–13): Contract/terms close window (target)

Next steps: if you confirm stakeholders and any additional docs you need, my team will finalize the MAP and share a Drive link. Would you be available for a 30-min stakeholder sync on Friday, Jul 2?

Thanks — looking forward to working through this with you.

—
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Europe
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-orchestration-template-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet); redwood-eu-data-flow-diagram.pdf (diagram); SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@eurobank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Pieter van Dijk <p.vandijk@eurobank.com>, DPO Team <dpo@eurobank.com>, LegalOps <legalops@eurobank.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EU Residency MAP orchestration: roles, cross-border checklist, and close windows

Markus —

Thanks for the clear outline and the template. Pieter and I reviewed the attachments; helpful to see the data flow at a glance. A few quick notes from our side:

- We will include the DPO (Sara Holm) and Legal (LegalOps) on the thread for any data transfer and contract questions.
- Primary requirement: all customer PII must be resident within EU-hosted infrastructure unless explicitly redacted; we will need the technical plan for how Redwood isolates EU-resident traffic.
- For cross-border transfers (e.g., telemetry/ops), we require a documented justification and mitigations; we expect to review the data minimization plan during the technical eval.

We can do Fri, Jul 2 at 10:00 CEST for the 30-min sync. Please send a calendar invite.

Claire Jensen
Head of Cloud Risk & Controls
EuroBank Corp

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@eurobank.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU Residency MAP orchestration: roles, cross-border checklist, and close windows

Claire / team —

Appreciate the quick feedback and the DPO/Legal leads. I’ll draft the MAP owners sheet with the contacts you’ve provided and circulate for sign-off by tomorrow EOD.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- EU-resident traffic: Redwood can pin model serving in EU regions and limit egress to EU-only endpoints as part of our Private deployment options. I’ll include a short tech note explaining routing, KMS options, and regional pinning.
- Telemetry/ops: by default we collect minimal telemetry for health/alerts; we can provide a scoped telemetry policy and a one-time export showing fields collected.

Attachments I’ll add to the MAP in Drive: a short "Regional Pinning & KMS note" and a sample IP allowlist guide.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@eurobank.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU Residency MAP orchestration: roles, cross-border checklist, and close windows

Claire / Pieter / Markus —

I’m Kimberly, Redwood’s Security & Compliance lead for EMEA. I’ll own evidence collection for SOC2, encryption, and network controls. A couple of items to flag so we can scope the technical eval:

1) Please send a short list of the data classes (e.g., customer PII, account identifiers, transaction metadata) and any retention constraints you have per class. This will let us produce targeted samples and retention policy excerpts.

2) If you require an independent attestation for cross-border processing we can coordinate a third-party report; otherwise our standard SOC2 + regionally pinned deployments and KMS integrations suffice for most customers.

I’ve uploaded the SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf and redwood-eu-data-flow-diagram.pdf to the Drive link Markus shared; will add a short Controls Readout doc before the Fri sync.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance, EMEA
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:45:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU Residency MAP orchestration: roles, cross-border checklist, and close windows

Thanks all — good sync earlier today. Quick recap and next actions (per our notes):

- EuroBank to provide: data class list (by Jul 6), primary legal contact for contract redlines (LegalOps), and confirmation on whether external attestation is required for cross-border flows.
- Redwood to provide: updated MAP with owners (Laura), regional pinning technical note and KMS options (Laura), Controls Readout and SOC2 summary (Kimberly), and staging access instructions (Rishi). Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2BcDEF-MAP-Drive
- Proposed milestone adjustments: Technical eval window Jul 12–16; decision meeting Jul 23; target legal close Aug 6–13.

Looking forward to the data-class list from our DPO so we can confirm the scope.

Best,
Pieter van Dijk
Head of Cloud Risk & Controls, EuroBank Corp
